details: Germany's Sparkassen savings-bank network began offering crypto trading to retail customers on October 19, 2026, supporting Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, Solana, and Polygon. The service, "Krypto – powered by Deka," is available through their banking app with a €0.99 fee per order. Initially, five banks are participating, with 30-40 more expected monthly, signaling a significant shift towards mainstream crypto adoption.
title: Germany's Sparkassen Launch Crypto Trading in Banking App

details: JPMorgan has made its JPM Coin, a deposit token representing dollar deposits, available on the Ethereum network for institutional clients. This expansion allows approved institutions to utilize Ethereum for payments, settling tokenized asset transactions, or moving collateral, leveraging Ethereum's liquidity and security. The move follows JPM Coin's prior deployment on Base and asset tokenization on Ethereum.
title: JPMorgan Extends JPM Coin to Ethereum for Institutional Clients

details: Cryptocurrency exchange Bitget is set to acquire GMO-Z.com Cryptonomics (Thailand), a licensed digital asset exchange and brokerage. This acquisition provides Bitget with a regulated foothold in the Thai market, expanding its presence in Southeast Asia and signaling consolidation within the crypto exchange industry. The deal is targeted for completion by October 31, 2026.
title: Bitget to Acquire GMO-Z.com's Thai Crypto Exchange

details: Despite Bitcoin's recent plunge toward $80,000, Wall Street hedge funds significantly reduced their bearish futures bets by nearly 15%. This suggests a reassessment of risks and potential underlying support for Bitcoin, as traders become less willing to bet on further declines even during price volatility.
title: Wall Street Bitcoin Bears Retreat Amid Price Plunge

details: Tether (USDT) saw a decrease of nearly $5 billion in its supply across various crypto exchanges and lenders in Q3, as competing stablecoins like USDC and Ripple's RLUSD gained liquidity. This shift indicates a growing competition in the stablecoin market, with rivals offering incentives to win deposits and trading collateral.
title: Tether Loses $5B in Liquidity as Rivals Gain Market Share

details: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has proposed EIP-8288, aimed at significantly reducing signature verification costs on the Ethereum network by over 99%. The proposal suggests moving complex cryptographic operations off the main blockchain, allowing users to generate STARK proofs locally and submit them through an aggregation mechanism, thereby improving efficiency and supporting quantum-resistant signatures.
title: Vitalik Buterin Proposes EIP-8288 to Cut Ethereum Signature Costs
